duration.text: The Project Management at Nanchang University is a 2.5 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2916 USD/per year ￥ 21000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Undergraduate certificate Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of Undergraduate school 5.Certificate of HSK Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 6.Statement of your research plan Including study purpose, research interest and research plan in brief. 7.Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents.

requirements.text: Hold a Bachelor's Degree. Pass HSK 6 or at least one year's Chinese language training from our university.
